description: The plot illustrates the Micro F1 percentage of KnowPrompt in relation to the number of training samples generated by LLMs. The x-axis is labeled but the label is not visible, has a linear scale, and ranges from 8 to 64 with tick labels at 8, 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis is labeled "Micro F1 (%)", has a linear scale, and ranges from 60 to 80 with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80. A single line is present in the plot, with a blue color, circular markers, and a solid line style; it starts at approximately 68 at x=8, increases to around 76 at x=16, and then gradually rises to about 78 at x=32 before leveling off to approximately 78 at x=64.
